sinopsis.es: Tras un camino migratorio de veinte años, la directora ve envejecer a su madre desde la distancia: su mente con demencia empieza a olvidar los pocos momentos que compartieron en Barcelona y Bogotá. Por teléfono, le brinda esos recuerdos para que los reviva y, al mismo tiempo, lucha por una reagrupación familiar y por estar presente para su hija.
sinopsis.en: After a long journey of migration lasting 20 years, the director faces her most difficult time: watching her mother age from afar and seeing how her dementia-ridden mind begins to forget those few moments they shared in Barcelona and Bogotá. Through the telephone conversations she has with her mother, she provides her with those memories so she can relive them, at the same time battling to bring the family back together again and be present for her daughter.
